target_decision.proposal: Redirect the received H5 subject label to one independently approved exact finite-automata theorem, or have the master split or reject the target if no faithful single root exists.

statement_blocker: The catalog supplies only the subject gloss 'the theory of finite automata'. It selects no source, automaton model, alphabet or state finiteness conventions, word and language encoding, transitions, acceptance semantics, ordered binders, hypotheses, conclusion, or boundary cases. DFA/NFA equivalence, regular-language closure, pumping, Myhill-Nerode, Kleene equivalence, minimization, and decision procedures are inequivalent results and several are separately owned targets. Choosing one would invent or substitute mathematics.
domain_and_universes: Open: the selected source must fix alphabet and state universes, the finite-state condition, word and language representations, the automaton model, transition and acceptance semantics, and all effectiveness structures.
conclusion: Open: the repository names a theory and supplies no truth-valued conclusion.
degenerate_case_status: No case is excluded before a proposition is selected; the statement phase must resolve every boundary case listed in scope-map.md.
candidate_scope_not_credited: equivalence of deterministic and nondeterministic finite automata by language acceptance
equivalence of regular expressions and finite automata
a characterization of regular languages such as Myhill-Nerode
a pumping lemma for finite-state accepted languages
closure of regular languages under Boolean or regex-like operations
minimal-automaton existence or uniqueness and a minimization algorithm
decidability of membership, emptiness, equivalence, or another finite-automata problem
degenerate_cases_to_resolve: empty word, empty language, and universal language
zero, one, finite, and infinite state types
empty start or accepting state sets and unreachable states
epsilon cycles and transitions that consume no symbol
partial transition tables and completion with a sink state
equality of automaton records versus equality of accepted languages
excluded_substitutions: THM-M-0760 Myhill-Nerode or THM-M-0761 pumping lemma used as this root
any word-acceptor, transducer, tree, Buchi, Rabin, probabilistic, weighted, alternating, or timed finite-state model selected without source approval
unbounded-memory pushdown, Turing, or linear-bounded machines substituted for the finite-automata subject
a DFA, NFA, or epsilon-NFA with an arbitrary possibly infinite state type presented as finite without an explicit finiteness condition
a structure field or hypothesis that assumes the desired theorem
an omnibus conjunction of unrelated standard automata results
the catalog's untrusted verified label, a survey row, bibliography entry, theorem name, or API probe as proof credit
